description: This file defines API for pattern-based subgraph rewrites in PyTorch's JIT compiler, including classes and functions for registering and applying pattern-based graph transformations.

classes.name: SubgraphRewriter
classes.description: Class providing API for pattern-based subgraph rewrites, including registration of patterns and applying rewrites to modules or graphs.

methods.name: runOnModule
methods.description: Executes pattern-based subgraph rewrites on all methods within a module.

methods.name: runOnGraph
methods.description: Executes pattern-based subgraph rewrites on a specific graph, with optional filtering.

methods.name: RegisterDefaultPatterns
methods.description: Registers a set of standard rewrite patterns.

methods.name: RegisterRewritePattern
methods.description: Registers a custom pattern and its replacement for subgraph rewriting.
